# Command reference

> Every scripts/bin entry point, test suite, Make target, Rake task and npm script in the theme, generated from the files that define them.

## Entry points (`scripts/bin/`)

The canonical implementations; `scripts/build`, `scripts/release` and `scripts/validate` are thin wrappers that forward here. Each prints its options with `--help`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`./scripts/bin/audit-consumer`](../../scripts/bin/audit-consumer) | audit a Jekyll consumer repo against this theme |
| [`./scripts/bin/build`](../../scripts/bin/build) | Simplified build command for zer0-mistakes Jekyll theme |
| [`./scripts/bin/giscus-discussions`](../../scripts/bin/giscus-discussions) | read, draft, and post the GitHub Discussions that back the site's Giscus comment threads. |
| [`./scripts/bin/install`](../../scripts/bin/install) | zer0-mistakes installer entrypoint (v2) |
| [`./scripts/bin/manifest`](../../scripts/bin/manifest) | generate _data/theme-manifest.yml |
| [`./scripts/bin/release`](../../scripts/bin/release) | Simplified release command for zer0-mistakes Jekyll theme |
| [`./scripts/bin/sync-plugins`](../../scripts/bin/sync-plugins) | copy/update theme plugins into a remote_theme consumer repo |
| [`./scripts/bin/test`](../../scripts/bin/test) | Unified test runner for zer0-mistakes Jekyll theme |
| [`./scripts/bin/validate`](../../scripts/bin/validate) | Canonical preflight validator for zer0-mistakes. |

## Test suites (`./test/test_runner.sh`)

`./scripts/bin/test` runs the lib, theme and integration tiers; `./test/test_runner.sh --suites <list>` runs theme suites by name (comma-separated). The groups come first.

| Option | Script | What it runs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--suites all` | — | core, deployment, quality, installer, site_generation, i18n, features |
| `--suites full` | — | core, deployment, quality, installer, site_generation, i18n, obsidian, features, playwright, playwright_snapshots |
| `--suites core` | [`test_core.sh`](../../test/test_core.sh) | Core Tests (Unit, Integration, Validation) |
| `--suites deployment` | [`test_deployment.sh`](../../test/test_deployment.sh) | Deployment Tests (Installation, Docker, E2E) |
| `--suites quality` | [`test_quality.sh`](../../test/test_quality.sh) | Quality Tests (Security, Accessibility, Compatibility, Performance) |
| `--suites installer` | [`test_installer.sh`](../../test/test_installer.sh) | Modular Installer Tests (Profiles, Deploy Plugins, Agents, AI Wizard) |
| `--suites site_generation` | [`test_site_generation.sh`](../../test/test_site_generation.sh) | Site Generation Tests (Config Matrix, Jekyll Build) |
| `--suites i18n` | [`test_i18n.sh`](../../test/test_i18n.sh) | i18n Translation Tests (Pipeline, URL Mapping, Theme Wiring) |
| `--suites obsidian` | [`test_obsidian.sh`](../../test/test_obsidian.sh) | Obsidian Tests (Wiki Links, Graph, Backlinks) |
| `--suites features` | [`test_features.sh`](../../test/test_features.sh) | Feature Registry Tests (Sync, Schema, References, Coverage Backlog) |
| `--suites playwright` | [`test_playwright.sh`](../../test/test_playwright.sh) | Playwright Smoke Tests (CSS, layout, behavioral DOM) |
| `--suites playwright_snapshots` | [`test_playwright.sh`](../../test/test_playwright.sh) | Playwright Snapshot Tests (homepage skin pixel regression) |
| `--suites audit` | [`test_audit.sh`](../../test/test_audit.sh) | Audit Tests (Manifest generation, consumer classification, fix mode) |

## Make targets

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make setup` | Set up development environment |
| `make install` | Alias for setup |
| `make test` | Run all tests and validations |
| `make test-verbose` | Run tests with verbose output |
| `make validate` | Run canonical preflight validation |
| `make validate-quick` | Run host-only validation checks |
| `make lint` | Run linting and code quality checks |
| `make convert-notebooks` | Convert Jupyter notebooks to Jekyll-compatible Markdown |
| `make convert-notebooks-dry-run` | Preview notebook conversion without making changes |
| `make convert-notebooks-force` | Force reconversion of all notebooks |
| `make list-notebooks` | List all notebooks to be converted |
| `make clean-notebooks` | Remove converted notebook markdown files |
| `make version` | Show current version |
| `make version-patch` | Preview patch release version changes |
| `make version-minor` | Preview minor release version changes |
| `make version-major` | Preview major release version changes |
| `make version-dry-run` | Preview version bump without applying changes |
| `make build` | Build the gem |
| `make build-dry-run` | Preview build process without creating gem |
| `make publish` | Deprecated: use release-patch, release-minor, or release-major |
| `make publish-dry-run` | Preview publish process without uploading |
| `make release-patch` | Full patch release workflow |
| `make release-minor` | Full minor release workflow |
| `make release-major` | Full major release workflow |
| `make push` | Push changes and tags to remote repository |
| `make status` | Show git status and gem info |
| `make clean` | Remove built gems and temporary files |
| `make clean-all` | Remove all generated files including dependencies |
| `make deps` | Install/update dependencies |
| `make check` | Run comprehensive health check |
| `make info` | Show project information |
| `make issue-triage` | Classify open issues -> .issues/worklists/<date>.md (read/plan only) |
| `make issue-status` | Issue triage dashboard (counts by disposition) |
| `make issue-plan` | Show what the resolve lane would dispatch this run (dry-run) |
| `make help` | Display this help message |

## Rake tasks

`bundler/gem_tasks` also provides `rake build`, `rake install` and `rake release`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `rake stats:generate` | Regenerate _data/content_statistics.yml |
| `rake preview:missing` | List all documents missing preview images |
| `rake preview:dry_run` | Preview what images would be generated (dry run) |
| `rake preview:generate` | Generate preview images for all collections |
| `rake preview:posts` | Generate preview images for posts only |
| `rake preview:docs` | Generate preview images for docs only |
| `rake preview:force` | Force regenerate all preview images |
| `rake preview:file` | Generate preview for a specific file (FILE=path/to/file.md) |
| `rake dev:serve` | Start Jekyll development server with Docker |
| `rake dev:build` | Build Jekyll site |
| `rake dev:doctor` | Run Jekyll doctor |
| `rake dev:validate` | Run canonical preflight validation |
| `rake dev:validate_quick` | Run host-only quick validation |
| `rake test:all` | Run all tests |
| `rake test:core` | Run core tests |
| `rake test:verbose` | Run verbose tests |
| `rake` | Default task: `test:all` |

## npm scripts

| Command | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run css:bootstrap` | `mkdir -p assets/css/vendor && sass --load-path=node_modules --no-source-map --style=compressed assets/css/theme-npm-entry.scss:assets/css/vendor/bootstrap-from-npm.css` |
| `npm run test:critical` | `playwright test --config=test/playwright.config.js --project=critical` |
| `npm run test:mobile` | `playwright test --config=test/playwright.config.js --project=smoke test/visual/core/responsive.spec.js` |
| `npm run test:regression` | `playwright test --config=test/playwright.config.js --project=regression-chromium --project=regression-firefox --project=regression-webkit` |
| `npm run test:smoke` | `playwright test --config=test/playwright.config.js --project=smoke` |
| `npm run test:snapshots` | `playwright test --config=test/playwright.config.js --project=snapshots` |
| `npm run test:update-snapshots` | `playwright test --config=test/playwright.config.js --project=snapshots --update-snapshots` |
| `npm run vendor:install` | `bash scripts/vendor-install.sh` |
| `npm run vendor:mermaid` | `mkdir -p assets/vendor/mermaid && cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js assets/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js` |
